name: scientific-illustrator
description: Design or recreate editable scientific figures in draw.io, PowerPoint, or WPS with bounded batch drawing, adaptive module routing, and model feedback at quality checkpoints.

interface.shortDescription: Build editable figures in draw.io, PowerPoint, or WPS.
interface.longDescription: Uses one backend-neutral four-role workflow with equivalent draw.io and presentation mappings. Windows PowerPoint uses COM. Mac PowerPoint uses an Office.js task pane and context.sync when connected, with native OOXML as a safe fallback. WPS uses an editable OOXML working copy with truthful open-state reporting and checkpointed application refresh. Presentation drawing preserves the user's foreground application by default. The Designer specifies layout and routing, the Drawer builds editable objects panel by panel, the Reviewer checks renderer fidelity and editability, and the Corrector returns object-level repairs.
defaultPrompt: 在 PowerPoint 或 WPS 中批量复刻参考图，零人工等待，保持原生可编辑，在逻辑检查点核对结构和渲染后定点修正。
在 draw.io 中批量复刻参考图，保持文字、图形、表格、图表和连线可编辑，仅对复杂模块动态判断绘制或局部裁剪。
根据研究内容选择 draw.io 或 PowerPoint，设计一张布局整齐、箭头清晰的可编辑科学插图。
